more.question: N6
more.good_when: The developers can see how the one way, invoices whose totals are right without anyone redoing the math, carries every role to its objective at every moment of use, not only while the accounting team prints. Today it leaves them unsure what to lean toward when they install the command for the accounting team, and when they update invoicer under their own library calls. When the accounting team hits a print that goes wrong, they also don't know what keeps that team from needing a developer. Choices at those moments (O2, O3, and the 'without asking a developer' part of O1) get no lean from the concept. Every idea should name the moment it holds the way at and what it gives that role, so that when a developer faces a choice at install, update or a failed print, the concept decides it.
